programs.title_tr: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Toz Metal Kusuru & Yere İndirmeler
programs.title_en: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Powder Metal Defect & Groundings
programs.current_status_tr: Yüksek basınçlı türbin disklerindeki mikroskobik toz metal kirliliği nedeniyle küresel çapta yüzlerce A320neo/A321neo uçağı planlanmamış motor bakımına alındı. Ortalama motor revizyon süresi (TAT) 250-300 günü buluyor.
programs.current_status_en: Contaminated powder metal in high-pressure turbine disks required accelerated inspections; hundreds of A320neo family jets grounded globally with MRO shop turnaround times reaching 250-300 days.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY filosundaki yaklaşık 30-40 adet A320/A321neo uçağı yerde bekliyor; kapasite açığını kapatmak için ıslak kiralama (wet lease) ve mevcut A320ceo uçaklarının hizmet ömrünü uzatma yoluna gidildi. Pegasus filosu ağırlıklı CFM LEAP motorlu olduğu için doğrudan etkilenmedi.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Turkish Airlines has 30-40 A321neo aircraft parked; capacity shortfall managed via wet leases and extending older A320ceo service lives. Pegasus remains largely unaffected due to CFM LEAP engine selection.
programs.timeline_horizon: 2026 yılı boyunca ve 2027 ilk yarısına kadar sürmesi bekleniyor.
programs.source_reference: RTX Corporation / FAA Airworthiness Directives (AD 2024-0044) / THY KAP Açıklamaları

programs.title_tr: Boeing 737 MAX Üretim Kısıtı (FAA Aylık 38 Tavanı) & Tedarik Zinciri
programs.title_en: Boeing 737 MAX FAA Monthly 38 Cap & Supply Chain Bottlecks
programs.current_status_tr: FAA'in kalite ve montaj denetimleri kapsamında Boeing 737 üretimini aylık 38 uçak tavanında tutması ve Spirit AeroSystems gövde teslimat gecikmeleri nedeniyle 2026 teslimat takvimleri 3-6 ay geriye ötelendi. MAX 7 ve MAX 10 sertifikasyonu gecikmeye devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: FAA capped 737 production at 38/month pending quality audit milestones; Spirit AeroSystems fuselage supply constraints pushed airline delivery slots back by 3 to 6 months. MAX 7 and MAX 10 certification remains pending.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: SunExpress ve THY teslimatları planlanan takvimin gerisinde seyrediyor; havayolları yoğun yaz ve sonbahar kapasite planlamalarını mevcut gövdelerle optimize ediyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: SunExpress and Turkish Airlines delivery streams experiencing slot postponements; carriers optimizing utilization on existing fleet assets.
programs.timeline_horizon: Aylık 38 üretim tavanının 2026 sonuna kadar aşamalı olarak artırılması hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: FAA Oversight Directives / Boeing Quarterly Deliveries / Airline Fleet Filings

programs.title_tr: Airbus A321XLR Ticari Teslimatları & Dar Gövde Uzun Menzil Devrimi
programs.title_en: Airbus A321XLR Entry into Service & Long-Range Narrowbody Wave
programs.current_status_tr: EASA tip sertifikasyonunu tamamlayan A321XLR, Iberia tarafından Madrid-Boston hattında ilk ticari uçuşlarına başladı. 4.700 deniz mili (8.700 km) menziliyle dar gövdede transatlantik ve kıtalararası uçuş maliyetlerini %30 düşürüyor.
programs.current_status_en: Having achieved EASA certification, the A321XLR commenced transatlantic operations with launch customer Iberia. Its 4,700 nm range unlocks thin long-haul routes at 30% lower trip cost.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Orta Doğu, Afrika ve ikincil Avrupa şehirlerine doğrudan bağlantı potansiyeli nedeniyle bölge taşıyıcıları tarafından yakından izleniyor. THY ve Pegasus filo stratejilerinde uzun vadeli alternatif.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Closely monitored by regional carriers for secondary point-to-point routes into Africa, Central Asia and Europe; potential long-term fit for Istanbul network.
programs.source_reference: EASA Type Certificate Data Sheet (TCDS) / Airbus Commercial Aircraft Updates

programs.title_tr: Boeing 777-9 (777X) Test Uçuşları & Hizmete Giriş Tarihi
programs.current_status_tr: İtiş kolu bağlantı elemanındaki (thrust link) teknik arıza sonrası test uçuşları geçici olarak durdurulmuştu; Boeing ilk teslimat takvimini 2026 yılına (ve potansiyel olarak 2027'ye) revize etti. Başta Emirates ve Lufthansa olmak üzere amiral gemisi filoları A380 ve 777-300ER ömür uzatmak zorunda kaldı.
programs.current_status_en: Structural component inspection on engine thrust links required test fleet pause; initial deliveries rescheduled to 2026/2027. Major customers Emirates and Lufthansa forced to extend legacy 777-300ER and A380 service lives.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY'nin geniş gövde siparişlerinde Airbus A350-1000'e ağırlık vermesinde 777X gecikmeleri belirleyici stratejik etken oldu.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Delays were a primary catalyst for Turkish Airlines' decision to anchor its high-capacity widebody order book on the Airbus A350-1000.
programs.timeline_horizon: FAA tip sertifikasyonu ve ilk ticari teslimat 2026 sonu / 2027 hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: Boeing Defense, Space & Security / Airline IR Filings / Emirates President Statements

programs.title_tr: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Yüksek Basınç Türbini Dayanıklılığı & MRO Bekleme Süreleri
programs.title_en: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Hot-Section Durability & Shop Visit Backlogs
programs.current_status_tr: Sıcak iklim, tozlu hava sahası ve yüksek iniş-kalkış döngüsü altında çalışan LEAP motorlarında türbin kanatçığı erozyonu nedeniyle planlanandan erken motor indirme yaşanıyor. Küresel MRO atölyelerinde yedek parça ve motor kıtlığı devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: Harsh environment operations (heat, sand, high cycle utilization) causing premature hot-section turbine blade wear; global MRO shops experiencing parts constraints and extended turn-around times.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Pegasus'un filosunun belkemiğini oluşturan A321neo uçaklarında CFM LEAP-1A motorları kullanılıyor. Pegasus, proaktif motor rotasyonu ve yedek motor rezervasyonu ile uçak yerde kalma süresini (AOG) asgaride tutuyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Pegasus relies heavily on CFM LEAP-1A on its A321neo fleet; carrier leverages proactive engine rotation and buffer lease pools to keep AOG rates minimal.
programs.timeline_horizon: CFM'in güncellenmiş dayanıklı parça (durability kit) teslimatları 2026 boyunca yaygınlaşıyor.
programs.source_reference: Safran / GE Aerospace Engine Technical Briefings / Aviation Week MRO Watch

stories.article_body: Alaska Airlines adds four new cities to its Seattle network, plus a new seasonal nonstop route to Guadalajara, Mexico
detailed_analysis: Alaska Airlines is expanding its Seattle hub with 4 new domestic routes launching in June 2027 to Charlotte, Des Moines, Jacksonville, and Norfolk.
Three transcontinental routes—Charlotte (eff 10JUN27), Jacksonville (eff 24JUN27), and Norfolk (eff 10JUN27)—will operate 1 daily flight using Boeing 737-900ER aircraft.
The Seattle to Des Moines route will launch on 24JUN27 with 1 daily flight operated by Horizon using Embraer E175 aircraft.
data_points: 1 daily Seattle – Des Moines (eff 24JUN27, Horizon Embraer E175)
stories.strategic_impact: The expansion strengthens Alaska Airlines' core Seattle hub by building out direct capacity to key US East Coast, Midwest, and transborder destinations.

market_exposure.details: Expands Seattle hub capacity with four new domestic cities and seasonal Guadalajara service in summer 2027.
Will operate the daily Seattle to Des Moines route on Embraer E175 aircraft.

stories.why_it_matters: The additions expand Alaska Airlines' network presence from Seattle across unserved domestic point-to-point markets and transborder leisure traffic.

stories.source_description: United Airlines is rapidly reshaping its customer proposition around premium experiences, loyalty, co-branded cards and ancillary revenue, according to a new 18-page IdeaWorksCompany report, “United is Winning the Race for Brand-Loyal Consumers.” Written by airline revenue and loyalty expert Jay Sorensen, the report examines United’s expanding portfolio of products and strategies introduced during 2025 and 2026. stories.headline: Virgin Australia Selects Delta TechOps for Fleetwide 737 Component Support
stories.lead: Virgin Australia has awarded Delta TechOps a five-year fleetwide component support contract for its Boeing 737 aircraft. The partnership expands an existing maintenance relationship across more than 100 narrowbody jets.
stories.source_description: Virgin Australia has selected Delta TechOps to provide fleetwide component support for its more than 100 Boeing 737NG and 737 MAX aircraft, expanding a on an existing maintenance relationship and further growing TechOps’ presence in the Asia-Pacific region. The five-year agreement covers airframe components along with engine components for both the CFM56-7B and CFM LEAP-1B engines. Delta TechOps teams will perform the work primarily in Atlanta and Minneapolis with logistics support from Virgin Australia in Singapore, Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney. TechOps previously supported the airline's CFM56-7B engines and completed component repairs across its fleet “Virgin Australia’s 737s are central to its operation, and we appreciate the confidence placed in Delta TechOps to support this fleet. As an airline operator ourselves, we understand what aircraft availability means to a schedule and to the customers who depend on it. Our teams bring that perspective — along with deep technical expertise across the CFM56-7B and LEAP-1B — to every component we support,” said Marc Meredith, Chief Commercial Officer for Delta TechOps. The selection reflects Delta’s growing reach in the Asia-Pacific region. Delta Air Lines recently expanded its presence in Australia with the launch of Los Angeles-Melbourne service and now serves Melbourne, Sydney and Brisbane. Delta TechOps also continues to broaden its support of airline customers across the Pacific, including providing maintenance for Korean Air’s CFM LEAP-1B engines, the same engine family that powers Virgin Australia’s Boeing 737 MAX aircraft. Backed by the experience of maintaining one of the world's largest airline fleets, TechOps supports more than 150 customers across six continents. As North America's largest MRO provider, TechOps services more than 100,000 aircraft components annually through 25 in-house component shops and remains the only provider in the Americas certified to support the CFM LEAP, Pratt & Whitney GTF and Rolls-Royce Trent engine families.

stories.headline: Boeing Commercial Market Outlook Projects Global Fleet Growth to 2045
stories.lead: Boeing forecasts that the global commercial aircraft fleet will grow nearly 80% to over 50,000 airplanes by 2045. Airlines and cargo operators will require nearly 44,000 new aircraft over the next 20 years to support air travel and cargo expansion.
stories.source_description: The global commercial airplanes fleet is expected to grow nearly 80% to more than 50,000 airplanes by 2045 as airlines and cargo operators add capacity. Globally, operators are forecasted to need nearly 44,000 new airplanes to support sustained air travel demand and air cargo expansion over the next 20 years. The global single-aisle fleet will nearly double to more than 36,000 jets, serving core short-haul networks and operating more than half of all global capacity. More than 8,000 widebody airplanes will be in service in 2045, enabling long-haul passenger routes, enhanced passenger experience and critical air cargo capacity. Air cargo traffic growth and the need for new-technology freighters to renew the fleet will drive demand for more than 2,900 production and converted freighters. Passenger traffic is expected to grow 4% annually, resulting in a doubling of global air traffic between 2026 and 2045.

stories.headline: London Heathrow Retains Top Spot in OAG Megahubs 2025 Connectivity Rankings
stories.lead: London Heathrow retained its title as the world's most connected airport for the third consecutive year in the OAG Megahubs 2025 ranking. Meanwhile, Istanbul Airport and Frankfurt registered substantial connectivity gains, while Tokyo Haneda experienced a decline.
stories.source_description: London Heathrow (LHR) retains its title as the world’s most connected airport for the third consecutive year , offering over 59,000 possible connections to 226 destinations* on the busiest day**. Istanbul Airport (IST) has seen one of the greatest increases, surging from 8 th position last year to 2 nd place in this year’s ranking, due to a 25% year-on-year increase in potential connections on the busiest day of the year. Frankfurt (FRA) has seen a significant shift in rankings, climbing from 10 th position last year to 4 th , driven by a 21% increase in potential connections year-on-year. Tokyo Haneda (HND) has dropped down in this year’s rankings from 3 rd in 2024 to 9 th in 2025, reflecting a 10% decline in connections. Atlanta Hartsfield-Jackson (ATL) – the world’s largest airport by seat capacity – re-enters the Top 10 this year rising from 11 th place last year to 8 th position in 2025. ATL has added eight (8) more destinations and seen a corresponding 14% increase in potential connections. Chicago O’Hare (ORD) also makes gains, climbing two (2) spots to 7th, due to a 17% growth in connections and an expanded network of 15 additional destinations.

stories.headline: Emirates Wins Gold at 2026 Global Performance Marketing Awards
stories.lead: Emirates was awarded Gold in the inaugural Best Travel, Leisure & Experience Campaign category at the 2026 Global Performance Marketing Awards for transforming its Asia Pacific affiliate marketing programme.
stories.source_description: Inaugural winner in the Best Travel, Leisure & Experience Campaign award category Recognised for the transformation of its Asia Pacific affiliate programme Performance marketing is a fundamental customer growth driver for Emirates Dubai, UAE, 12 November 2026: Emirates has won Gold in the inaugural Best Travel, Leisure & Experience Campaign category at the 2026 Global Performance Marketing Awards. Emirates was recognised as the first-ever winner of the Best Travel, Leisure & Experience Campaign award for its work to transform its affiliate marketing programme in Asia Pacific (APAC) - one of the world’s most competitive travel markets where online travel agencies, airlines and travel agents all compete for the same affiliate partners. The airline rebuilt its affiliate marketing programme by shifting from broad publisher volumes to a refined partner base that works harder without sacrificing efficiency, strengthening direct relationships, and focusing on investments that delivered the greatest impact, along with expanding into new affiliate partner categories. As a result, the airline’s revenue growth from performance marketing in APAC rose 31% in a single year. At Emirates, performance marketing operates as a strategic engine for customer growth, not only as a marketing channel. An internal team of specialists combine channel expertise with advanced analytics, attribution, customer insights and rich first-party data, and keep a consistent focus on driving incremental revenue, customer quality and lifetime value. Boutros Boutros, Executive Vice President, Corporate Communications, Marketing & Brand for Emirates Group, said : “We’re proud to be recognised at the Global Performance Marketing Awards. This accolade underscores the team’s commitment to deliver real value for our customers and for the business. Performance marketing is a fundamental commercial growth driver for Emirates, and the team’s rigorous, data-led approach combined with smart automation, delivers substantial value back to the business. Their success is driven by clear strategy, well-defined objectives and disciplined execution, and we’ve improved both the quality of our bookings and revenue outcomes in APAC. It’s a win-win, and congratulations to all the teams involved.” Emirates’ performance marketing at a glance A core team in Dubai covers affiliate marketing, paid search and metasearch, supported by over 60 digital marketing colleagues and hundreds of partners globally. Together, these three channels delivers more than a third of new customers acquired through emirates.com. The team manages strategy and execution for more than 5,000 always-on campaigns worldwide across search engines, flight search websites and affiliate marketing partners. Big data from partners powers this always-on engine and guides strategic investment decisions supporting more than 4,000 routes in 80 markets. High levels of automation and strict processes allow the team to operate at this scale while keeping decisions consistent, with dedicated specialists across each discipline ensuring best-in-class execution and governance. Exclusive partnerships enable Emirates to bring industry-first and industry-leading advertising solutions to market. About the awards The Global Performance Marketing Awards recognise work that drives measurable growth across performance and partnership marketing, and represent the collaborative efforts of brands, agencies, publishers and technology platforms. Entries are scored independently by multiple senior judges from brands, agencies and publishers across the industry, assessing each entry on strategic clarity, quality of execution, partnership collaboration and measurable commercial impact. This latest win follows Emirates’ shortlisting at the Global Search Awards for Best Use of Search (Travel/Leisure).

stories.headline: Delta Reaches 50th KABOOM! Playground Milestone in Seattle
stories.lead: Delta Air Lines completed its 50th community playground in partnership with KABOOM! near its Seattle hub.
stories.source_description: On Saturday, Nov. 7, more than 100 Delta employees, SkyMiles and 12Status Members and neighbors came together to build Delta's 50th KABOOM! playground and seventh in the Seattle area. Delta partnered with the City of SeaTac to replace the aging playground at McMicken Heights Park, which is across the street from a local elementary school. The new playspace is estimated to serve 800 children each year. The milestone was reached during KABOOM!’s 30 year anniversary. With fewer places to play, a safe playground close to home matters. Designed by children, built by community The playground's design came straight from local children, who shared their ideas at a KABOOM! Design Day. On build day, Delta and KABOOM! volunteers brought those ideas to life. "Every playground starts with the community," said Allison Marques, General Manager – Delta Community Engagement. "Somewhere in this neighborhood is a child who drew their dream slide. Today, it's real. That's why Delta people keep volunteering, 50 playgrounds later." The new playground includes slides, swings and climbing features, and plenty of room to explore. Volunteers also improved the area around the playground by painting and planting new flowers. Delta people show up for Seattle Every playground needs a foundation, and at Delta's KABOOM! builds, that job usually falls to Team Cement. Tracey Baldwin, Senior Manager – Corporate Security, has led it at more than 25 builds since 2017, and Seattle was no different. "If the cement's not good, then the playground's not good," she said. She had plenty of help. Delta volunteers from Seattle and across the country worked with 12Status SkyMiles Members, community partners, and, in the afternoon, Seattle Seahawks legend Cliff Avril. For Tracey, that shared purpose is what keeps her coming back. "All of these people fly in from all over the United States for one common goal," she said. "At Delta, we talk about helping others, but I don't know if we realize we're helping our own people, too. Volunteering’s restored my faith that there are still good people out there who want to do good things." Delta in Seattle For Delta, Seattle is more than a destination. It's home. This year alone: $2.6M+ given by Delta and The Delta Air Lines Foundation to 19 Seattle nonprofit partners 568+ volunteer hours from Delta people, sorting food, clearing trails and showing up for their neighbors In all, Delta's community work has positively impacted more than 266,000 lives in Seattle. On Nov. 7, that impact could be seen in a brand-new playground. Delta has partnered with KABOOM! since 2013 to build playgrounds alongside communities across the country, giving back to the places where we call home. Over the years, thousands of Delta volunteers have worked with local partners and neighbors to create playgrounds shaped by the communities they're built for because children deserve safe places to play.
